extension.lead: Browser download helper: resolve the current page video URL, scan page media, batch-scrape lists, and send everything to your local MediaFlow download queue.
extension.feature1: One-click send into the local download queue
extension.feature3: Handy for YouTube and other common sites
extension.how1: Install the extension and pin it to the toolbar
extension.how3: On a video page: Send to MediaFlow or Scan page
extension.how4: On list pages use Batch scrape; for login walls, Sync Cookies first
extension.purpose1: Current video page URL goes straight into the desktop download queue.
extension.purpose2: Find media on the page, multi-select, then send to MediaFlow.
extension.purpose3: Grab multiple items from profile or list pages in one go.
extension.purpose4: Reuse browser login state to reduce age-gate / login-wall failures.
extension.tip1: Keep the desktop app open before sending, or the extension cannot deliver jobs.
extension.tip2: Cookie sync needs the desktop LAN/Mobile helper (port 8765).
extension.tip3: Some sites work better if you log in first, then sync cookies.
extension.f1Desc: Detect the current page video address and send it to the desktop Media Download queue.
extension.f2Desc: Find downloadable media on the page, multi-select, then batch-send—not only single watch pages.
extension.f3Desc: Scroll profile/list pages to download many items; optional date and keyword filters.
extension.f4Desc: Adapters for TikTok / Douyin / Instagram / X; other sites use generic media discovery.
extension.f5Desc: Sync browser login state to desktop to reduce age-gate and login-wall failures.
extension.f6Desc: Right-click send, floating panel on video pages, and customizable shortcuts.
extension.f7Desc: Optional: detect video links copied to the clipboard and send them easily.
extension.f8Desc: Track sent items; smart incremental mode skips already-downloaded videos.
extension.tip4: Sites without a dedicated adapter can still use “Scan page media”.
extension.title: MediaFlow Browser Extension
extension.note: Free & open source · keep MediaFlow desktop running
extension.how2: Open the MediaFlow desktop app (fully free, no activation)
